title: Common security questions for Everyone Pay
summary: This document explains Everyone Pay security block behavior: blocks prevent blocked users from sending payment requests, and blocked users are notified they have been blocked. It also provides troubleshooting steps if you still see activity from a blocked user, including verifying profile match and contacting support with screenshots.
